stories.headline: No proven cognitive benefit from testosterone for menopause 'brain fog'
stories.why: A cautious null: too little evidence to say either way. Relevant to the wider debate on testosterone outside classic deficiency.
points: Review pooled 3 randomised trials, 244 postmenopausal women
No measurable gain in planning, learning or memory
Authors: a lack of evidence, not evidence of no effect
stories.study: Review of 3 small RCTs; no perimenopausal women; reported via secondary coverage
